text:
Correction: you have ~200 lines of YOUR OWN further store-split work still UNCOMMITTED, and you mislabeled it as "other lanes' pre-existing changes." It is NOT — these three files are your domain-split work:
- cart/hmsc-int/data/index.ts (+93 beyond the a658bbc4f commit)
- cart/hmsc-int/editors/store.ts (+42)
- cart/hmsc-int/editors/workbench/items/store.ts (+75)

The set-aside dirty tree (other lanes' ~400 files) is real, but those three store files are yours. Do this:
1. `tools/rjit game verify` first — confirm the split is GREEN with this uncommitted work present (you may have verified an earlier state).
2. Commit ONLY those three files (+ manifest.json if its newline matters) with EXPLICIT paths — NOT git add -A. Honest message; if this continuation is incomplete, say "wip" in it.
3. Report the new SHA and the verify result.

Do not touch world_loader.zig / framework/gpu / constructor.zig (pane 5's lane). Commit-to-prevent-loss is standing here — don't leave your own work uncommitted thinking it belongs to someone else.
resolution: Verified the current dirty store-split state before committing: tools/rjit game verify was GREEN (oracle 1/1, round-trips 2/2, render 1/1, suites 71/71, scripts 3/3). Then committed only the remaining store-split files explicitly: data/index.ts telemetry/domain timing continuation, editors/store.ts env/probe continuation, workbench/items/store.ts domain-store continuation, plus the manifest formatting delta. Protected loader/render lane files were not touched by this commit.
